question: Which of the following is the formula of barium peroxide
solution:
The correct answer is __BaO2__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Barium Peroxide: 

 
 
• It is a greyish-white granular solid.
 
• Its chemical formula is BaO2.
 
• It is a non-combustible chemical.
 
 
• Though it accelerates the rate of combustion of combustible materials.
 
 
 
• It is used as a bleaching agent, in making Hydrogen Peroxide, aluminium welding and textile dyeing.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The chemical formula of Barium Oxide is BaO.
 
• Barium:
 
 
• Symbol: Ba
 
• Atomic mass: 137.327 u
 
• Atomic number: 56
